bio: A charming modern restaurant serving ambitious seasonal cuisine that is strongly influenced by the region and often incorporates home-grown fruit and vegetables. The set menu has four, six or eight courses; its vegetarian counterpart comes in a four- or five-course format. The service is friendly and the wine recommendations helpful. In the attractive courtyard, there is also a bakery, a farm shop and a farm café, as well as a hotel. Alternatively, Hasenpfeffer is open in the evenings for traditional dishes with modern influences....
